setup.title: Welcome to Cash Bowl
setup.intro: This is the first run: create your account. You will be the administrator and can then create accounts for the rest of the household.

dashboard.title: My month
dashboard.overspent: You are {amount} over what was available. Set aside so far: {saved}.

drafts.one: You have {count} draft to sort out this month: it is not counted in any total.
drafts.other: You have {count} drafts to sort out this month: they are not counted in any total.

dashboard.savedDraft: Draft saved. You will find it under “To sort out”.

entry.privateLabel: Private expense: only you will see it

plan.title: This month's plan
plan.intro: Kakebo starts here: what comes in, what goes out on its own, and how much you want to set aside. Income and fixed costs are always shared.
plan.goalLabel: How much you want to set aside this month

entryEdit.author: Entered by {name}.
entryEdit.draftNotice: This entry is still a draft: it is not counted in any total. Fill in amount, category and date, then press “Save”.

drafts.title: To sort out
drafts.intro: Drafts stay out of every total until they have an amount, a category and a date. That is the point: record on the spot, sort out later.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The four kakebo categories do not change: they are the method. Under each one you can create the sub-categories you need. A sub-category already in use is not deleted but deactivated, so the history stays readable.

profile.title: My profile
profile.passwordSaved: Password changed. Your other devices will have to sign in again.
profile.reducedMotionHint: Removes transitions. Your phone may already ask for this.

admin.title: Household users
admin.caption: Who can sign in to this installation
admin.name: Name
admin.resetHint: For when a household member has forgotten their password.

errors.categoryNameTaken: A category with this name already exists.
errors.rootCategoryFixed: The four kakebo categories always stay active.
errors.categoryInUse: Only sub-categories never used can be deleted. The others are deactivated.
errors.adminOnly: This page is for administrators only.

errors.receiptNotAnImage: This file is not a JPEG or PNG photo.

receipt.resizeFailed: The photos could not be shrunk: they will be sent as they are.
receipt.newAlt: Preview of photo {n} you are about to save
receipt.ocrButton: Read the amount from the receipt
receipt.ocrHint: The first time it downloads about 4 MB, then it stays on your phone.
receipt.ocrFound: Suggested amount: check it before saving.
receipt.ocrNotFound: No amount could be read. Please type it in.

reports.title: Reports

draftsExcluded.one: There is {count} draft in this period, not counted.
draftsExcluded.other: There are {count} drafts in this period, not counted.

reports.printHint: In the print dialog choose “Save as PDF”.

monthEnd.title: Closing the month
monthEnd.intro: The four kakebo questions. The app answers the first three; the last one is the one that matters, and you write it.
monthEnd.q1: How much did you have available?
monthEnd.q2: How much did you want to set aside?
monthEnd.q4: How much did you actually set aside?
monthEnd.q5: How can you do better next month?

settings.title: Maintenance
settings.backupIntro: The program makes one copy a day on its own and keeps the last {keep}. You will find them in {path}: if that folder sits inside a synced folder (Drive, Dropbox, Nextcloud), the copy leaves the house by itself.
settings.receiptsNote: Receipt photos are ordinary files in {path}: they sync as a folder, without being duplicated every day.
settings.downloadDatabaseHint: The file to put back in place to go back. It does not contain the photos.
settings.downloadJsonHint: It opens in a text editor and can be imported back below.
settings.restoreWarning: Careful: importing REPLACES everything there is now. The program makes a backup first, and afterwards everyone will have to sign in again. Receipt photos are not in the file: put them back by copying the folder.
settings.restoreFile: JSON file exported from Cash Bowl
settings.restoreSubmit: Replace the data with this file

recurring.title: Recurring entries
recurring.intro: Rent, bills, subscriptions, salary: set them once and every month they enter on their own, already valid. The current month ({month}) has been filled in already.
recurring.empty: No recurring entries yet. Add one below.
recurring.dayHint: (1 to 28, so it exists in February too)
recurring.addHint: It applies from the current month onwards: past months are not touched.
recurring.created: Recurring entry “{name}” created: it is already in the current month.
recurring.updated: Recurring entry updated. Months already recorded stay as they were.
recurring.removed: Recurring entry deleted. Entries already recorded stay where they are.

goals.title: Savings goals
goals.intro: Separate piggy banks: holiday, emergency fund, new car. When you set money aside, you record it here. They never touch the monthly figures: kakebo stays what it is.
goals.empty: No goals yet. Create one below.
goals.name: Name
goals.deleteGoal: Delete the goal and its movements
